title: PRD dependency reconciliation and staggered sign-off runway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Coordinate a reconciled list of cross-team dependencies, establish a staggered sign-off runway (design -> eng -> legal), and produce a minimal acceptance checklist for PRD handover. Goal: reduce rework cycles by clarifying requirements, owners, and artifacts for each review lane and to surface any blockers to the Private Upgrade milestone.
acceptance_criteria: All cross-team dependency owners identified with contact and backup owner
Documented acceptance checklist per team (Design QA checklist, Eng infra & perf tests, Legal privacy/terms items)
Signed timeline for staggered reviews with dates and micro-deadlines agreed by stakeholders
Playbook entry in Confluence that describes escalation path if a review slips >3 business days
At least one end-to-end runbook verifying PRD scope against telemetry and migration impacts
decision_summary: We will adopt a staggered sign-off runway instead of parallel sign-off to reduce iteration loops: Design finalizes mocks and interaction spec first, Engineering begins implementation against a frozen interface with a defined compatibility window, Legal performs a focused review on dataflow & terms once implementation contracts are stable. Trade-off: small delay to overall sign-off window in exchange for fewer rework cycles and clearer owner accountability.
